title: Kainos's Workday practice is an HR core, not a workflow engine, so it evidences only platform scale
content:
Kainos carries a major Workday practice — recorded in the workbook as Europe's largest boutique partner — alongside Microsoft and AWS credentials. The finding concerns what that practice is: Workday is an HR core rather than a workflow engine, so the tooling reveals no gap between what the platform does and what an attributed decision record would add.

The conclusion the research draws is deliberately narrow. The practice proves the firm can carry a major platform business, and nothing more. There is no identified missing record layer to point at, so there is no fit statement to make — only evidence of scale, which is not by itself a reason to approach anyone.

That is why the lead sits at 'do not pitch'. It is a screening outcome rather than a judgement on the firm, and writing it down prevents the Workday credential from being mistaken later for evidence of workflow relevance simply because it is a large enterprise platform.
